title: Generator produces one structure for every seed
body:
The procedural generator varies flavour but not structure. Every seed yields the same 7-room, two-fight gauntlet with 2 enemies and 3 endings and exactly 20,272 search states (checked for seeds 0-4, -5 and 123456789), so the "moving proof input" the README describes is structurally a single point. If generated packs are meant to keep the verifier from becoming a memorized target, vary room count, gating shape and ending structure under the same validator bar.

Audit report: https://claude.ai/artifact/SD45nGH1YqftoSvkxL8Hbb (2026-09-22, main c17192f9).
